evals.prompt: Design a logo for Kiln, a small-batch specialty coffee roaster in Istanbul. It should feel warm, crafted and modern — not rustic cliché. It needs to work on coffee bags, paper cups and as an Instagram avatar. Give me three directions and your recommendation.
evals.expected_output: A short brief with stated assumptions, three distinct concepts (different mark types) built as clean SVG without live text, each with a one-sentence idea and rationale, tested at small sizes/one colour, a greyscale-first presentation and a clear recommendation.

evals.prompt: I'm launching Tidepool, an open-source log search tool for developers. I need a logo I can use in the README, as a favicon and as an app icon. Keep it simple and technical but friendly.
evals.expected_output: A simple, distinctive symbol + wordmark lockup in SVG, audited and previewed, plus exported favicon, app-icon, one-colour black/white variants and short usage notes.

evals.prompt: Here's our logo (logo.svg). Be honest: what's wrong with it, and how would you refresh it without losing recognition?
evals.expected_output: A structured critique with scorecard and top-3 prioritised fixes, an equity audit, and an evolutionary refresh proposal (optionally a revised SVG).
